entries: Can you cut wood with a pick? Certainly, if you like to waste all day doing it. Give me a sturdy axe any day!
你能用镐头砍柴吗？当然能，如果你乐意浪费一整天的话。不过无论何时，我都宁愿要一把结实的斧头！
I don't remember her anymore... but... I think she knew of the blue light.
我已经不记得她了……可是……我想，她曾知晓蓝光。
I still see things outside of the village, on the edge of the fog. But never near the graveyard. Perhaps there is nothing there that they want.
我仍能在村外看见一些东西，它们总在迷雾，总在边缘。可它们从不靠近墓地。也许那里没有它们想要的东西。
Are you what I think you are? Here, in the village? Strange times these are...
莫非你正如我所想？就在此地，就在村里？这世道真是古怪……
I followed the blue light into the fog, but it abandoned me... why?
我跟着蓝光走进了迷雾，它却抛下了我……为什么？
I live here, but my home is the woods. It saddens me that the fog has thoroughly filled them. I cannot even remember much about them anymore. Wherever there is fog, my memory fails.
我住在这里，但我的家在林中。令我悲伤的是，迷雾。它已将那片林子彻底吞没。我甚至不再记得它的许多模样。凡有迷雾之处，我的记忆便随之衰退。

The caves... I took shelter in them from time to time. They helped me regain my thoughts and press on. Without them I would have been lost forever. But be careful. The deep holes are easy to miss in the fog.
那些洞穴……我时常在其中躲避。它们帮我重拾思绪、继续前行。没有它们，我早就永远迷失了。但千万小心。那些深洞很容易隐没在迷雾，稍不留神就会错过。
There is a forest nearby called... Kalindros, or... Kalindross. I cannot recall exactly, but perhaps they are related.
附近曾有一片森林，叫……卡林德罗斯，或者……卡林德劳斯。我记不确切了，但也许它们有渊源。
I carried one with me into the fog. I do not remember why. Here. You may have it. I cannot read, even if there was anything on those pages.
我曾带着一本书走进迷雾。我不记得为什么。给。你可以拿走它。就算那些书页上写着什么，我也读不了了。
Something about you I don't like. You should have stayed in the fog.
你身上有某种我不喜欢的东西。你本该留在迷雾里的。
What is that? I have never heard of it.
那是什么？我从未听说过。
I am unaware of such a name. Try asking the the town smith. He remembers far more than most. I find it quite odd.
我不知晓这个名字。去问问镇上的铁匠吧。他记得的东西比大多数人多得多。我觉得这相当古怪。
There are many kinds. They like the rocky crags beyond the woods. Yes, the woodlands are a lovely place and just full of them. We are talking about squirrels, aren't we?
它们种类繁多。喜欢林外的嶙峋山崖。是啊，林地是个可爱的地方，到处都是它们。我们说的是松鼠，对不对？

I was harvesting wood from the old orchard recently and was forced to flee for my life. The trees had come to life. When the fear wore off, I thought how marvelous it would be to obtain some of that wood. The things I could make... would you retrieve some for me?
我最近去老果园伐木，不得不为保命而逃。那些树活了过来。等惊恐消退后，我想：若能弄到那种木料该有多奇妙。我能做出来的东西……你愿意替我取一些回来吗？
I do not remember you... are you one of the fogborn?
我不记得你……你是雾生者之一吗？
I used to see it travelling through the town at night. It would go into the fog, and I would follow. That is what first led me into the fog.
我过去常在夜里看见它穿行镇上。它会走进迷雾，而我便跟上去。正是它第一次把我引进了雾中。

The light no longer travels... I know not why, and I have given up trying to solve its mysteries. I have already lost so much...

Now there are other blue lights in the fog, and I dare not follow them.

那道光不再出现了……我不知缘由，也已放弃解开它的谜团。我失去的已经太多……

如今，另有蓝光隐没于迷雾。我不敢再跟上去。
I've been into it... many times. Why do I remember that I don't remember? The others don't know what they've lost... they think all is well. But I know better.
我进过里面……很多次。为什么我偏偏记得“我不记得了”？其他人不知道他们失去了什么……他们以为一切都好。但我清楚得很。

The further I went into it, the more I lost myself. At the same time, I felt I was nearing some truth. And yet the things I saw on the edge of the fog... they were always on the edge, no matter how deep I went...
我走得越深，失去的自我就越多。同时，我又感到自己离某种真相越来越近。可我在迷雾边缘看见的那些东西……无论我走多深，它们始终在边缘……
Wood. Chop it. Collect it. Burn it. This is my life. Or it was... until I chased the blue light into the fog. I try to get by now... but I lost much while searching. I saw things... in the forest...
木头。劈它。收它。烧它。这就是我的命。或者说，曾是我的命……直到我追着蓝光，走进迷雾。现在我只是勉强过活……追寻的路上我失去了太多。我在森林，看见了东西……
I saw you wander into the fog. You know what secrets lurk there don't you?
我看见你走进了迷雾。你知道那里潜伏着什么秘密，对吧？
The orchard is to the west. Be careful. What once was harvested now seeks to harvest us. I cannot say how this has occurred but it must be the work of the dark lord.
果园在西边。千万小心。昔日被收获的东西，如今想要收获我们。我说不上这怎么会发生，但幕后黑手一定是黑暗领主。
Ore is not where my knowledge lies.
Of course they all say he was defeated. But the things I have seen in the forest... could they be natural? I... don't remember enough to know for sure. They just feel wrong.
他们当然都说他已被击败。但我在森林里看见的那些东西……它们可能是自然的吗？我……记不清了，无法确定。它们就是感觉不对劲。
I often hear music wafting through the trees when I am gathering wood. I dare not find its source. The forest is dangerous these days.
我拾柴时，常听见乐声穿过林间飘来。我不敢去寻找它的源头。这些日子，森林很危险。
Perhaps axes and bows are not your strong suit.
也许斧头和弓并非你的拿手好戏。
This wood is incredible! In all my days I have never seen anything like it. Well, at least not that I can remember.
这木料真是不可思议！我这一生从未见过这样的东西。好吧，至少从我还能记得的部分来说。
I can see that the fog has not touched you old friend.
看得出迷雾未曾侵染你，老伙计。
I do not see them in the woodlands often. They prefer cooler, damper environment. I even recall they... they had... what are we talking about again?
我在林地不常看见斯卡芬。它们偏好更阴凉潮湿的环境。我甚至记得它们……它们有……我们刚才在说什么来着？
This name... I have no love for this name, though... I cannot recall why.
这名字……我对这名字毫无好感，可是……我想不起为什么了。
When you say that word I see a symbol in my mind. You must stop! You will drive me even more mad.
你说出那个词时，我脑中就浮现一个符号。你必须停下！你会把我逼得更疯的。
I hope the book suits you more than it did me. But I do wish I knew why I carried it into the fog. Perhaps it had something to do with the blue light.
希望这本书对你比我合用。不过我确实想知道，我当初为何要把它带进迷雾。也许它和蓝光有些关系。
I reckon you can wield an axe better than most. But strength is not the most important factor in splitting wood. If you miss the wood altogether your strength means nothing.
我估摸你用斧头比大多数人都强。但劈木头，力气并非最关键。若你压根劈偏了，再大的力气也白搭。
I have no love for that name, though... I cannot recall why.
我对那个名字毫无好感，只是……想不起为什么了。
I make most of my living there. But the woods have grown dangerous and strange. If the fog wasn't bad enough, now the trees move, as though possessed.
我大半的生计都靠这片林子。但林子变得又危险又古怪。先是迷雾。现在连树木也动了，像是被附了身。
Dark times are coming and are here already! My memory of the forest fades each day, and as it does, so goes my life, and my craft.
黑暗的时代正在到来，而且已经到了！我对森林的记忆一天天消退，随之而去的，是我的生活，我的手艺。
